description: Reference provenance and proposed Pig Litter behavior. Product evidence starts unverified.

requirements.title: Team identity and roster

reference.observation: One session has a team identity and a member roster.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Keep one versioned team roster per root session.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: All members see the same team and member identities.

requirements.title: Flat teammate membership

reference.observation: The reference team is flat and teammates cannot spawn teammates.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Allow only the lead to create teammates while retaining ordinary child delegation.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A teammate cannot create a teammate and can still use authorized ordinary delegation.

requirements.title: Named subagents and teammates

reference.observation: A name selects teammate creation in the reference Agent tool; unnamed calls create ordinary subagents.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Use explicit team creation and keep named litter children as ordinary children.

reference_relationship.reason: The reference selects teammate creation by name. Pig Litter retains named ordinary children and uses an explicit team_spawn tool.

requirements.acceptance_assertion: A named ordinary child remains a child and team_spawn creates a teammate.

requirements.title: Names and reserved addresses

reference.observation: The reference reserves several addresses and resolves case-insensitive teammate-name collisions with numeric suffixes.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Validate reserved names and control characters, and document the teammate collision rule.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Reserved and invalid names fail; duplicate requests follow the documented collision rule without impersonation.

requirements.title: Member identity and generation

reference.observation: Member records carry identity and join time; stale shutdown approval is checked against membership.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Bind members and privileged responses to a team and member generation.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A response for an earlier member generation cannot affect its replacement.

requirements.title: Roster persistence and recovery

reference.observation: Team metadata mutators use locking and identity-aware updates.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Persist versioned membership and detect stale leaders on recovery.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Restart recovers the intended roster without reviving a stale leader.

requirements.title: Startup rollback

reference.observation: Before startup commits, a failed spawn rolls back provisional membership and owned backend resources.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Roll back provisional membership when teammate startup fails.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A failed launch leaves no member or owned process behind.

requirements.title: Shared team workspace

reference.observation: The approved plan permits concurrent teammate writers in a shared checkout.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Allow concurrent writers only for explicit team membership.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Two teammates can write in one checkout while ordinary child writer guards still apply.

requirements.title: Optional isolated worktrees

reference.observation: The approved plan offers explicit per-teammate worktrees.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Track worktree ownership and preserve uncommitted changes.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Teammate edits stay in their worktrees and cleanup preserves uncommitted work.

requirements.title: Idle teammate lifetime

reference.observation: Teammate turns can become idle and emit an idle notification.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Keep an idle teammate addressable and wake it on a peer message; preserve explicit pause.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A message wakes an idle member but does not resume an explicitly paused member.

requirements.title: Teammate tool registration

reference.observation: The reference starts in-process and pane teammates with explicit team context.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Register team tools in member runtimes without widening ordinary child controls.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A teammate has the team tools and an ordinary unselected session does not.

requirements.title: Member and child authority

reference.observation: Teammates, ordinary subagents, and independent sessions are distinct relationships.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Keep team messaging separate from immediate-parent child control.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A sibling cannot inspect, pause, wait for, or resume another member through child controls.

requirements.title: Spawn policy hooks

reference.observation: Spawn hooks may refuse, rewrite, or retype a requested agent.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Honor enforceable spawn policy without publishing a denied member.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A denied spawn returns feedback and leaves no published member.

requirements.title: Attributed ordinary messages

reference.observation: Plain messages carry a sender and are rendered as attributed teammate input.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Deliver attributed peer text to the addressed member.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: The recipient sees the sender and body once without a lead provider request.

requirements.title: Single-recipient addressing

reference.observation: The reference addresses one recipient and rejects broadcast.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Require one resolved destination for each send.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A broadcast address is refused and individual sends reach only their intended recipients.

requirements.title: Message content validation

reference.observation: The reference checks empty messages, addresses, summaries, and frame-shaped input.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Validate target and body at the send boundary.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Empty content, invalid targets, and protocol-shaped ordinary text fail with no delivery.

requirements.title: Message queue and backpressure

reference.observation: Per-member inboxes track unread messages under a lock.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Bound pending inboxes and report capacity without losing accepted messages.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: The first over-capacity send fails while prior accepted messages remain recoverable.

requirements.title: Acceptance and transcript acknowledgement

reference.observation: The plan requires separate durable inbox acceptance and native transcript acknowledgement.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Acknowledge acceptance after persistence and consumption after observed native transcript storage.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A crash after acceptance and before transcript acknowledgement recovers one delivery.

requirements.title: Replay and duplicate suppression

reference.observation: The plan requires retryable receipts and suppression by message ID across crashes.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Retain stable message IDs and delivery receipts across restart.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Replaying the same ID after restart cannot append a duplicate recipient message.

requirements.title: Sender provenance

reference.observation: Reference entries classify sender provenance as verified, forged, or unverifiable.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Derive sender identity from the execution and expose provenance without treating a writable ledger as authentication.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A forged sender is marked and cannot authorize a privileged action.

requirements.title: Peer text is not authority

reference.observation: Privileged responses require sender and request checks.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Treat attributed peer text as data, never as user consent or permission.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A peer message requesting permission or imitating a lead decision does not grant it.

requirements.title: Message wrapper escaping

reference.observation: The reference escapes text that could close its message wrapper.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Keep untrusted text inside its attribution boundary.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Wrapper-closing text remains visible as peer content and cannot escape its attribution.

requirements.title: Delivery failures

reference.observation: The reference distinguishes delivery and routing failures.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Return explicit failure or uncertainty instead of claiming an unconfirmed delivery.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Persistence and delivery faults produce distinct non-success results without dropping accepted messages.

requirements.title: No lead inference relay

reference.observation: The plan prohibits using a lead model turn to relay a teammate message.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Route teammate messages through runtime services without a lead model request.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A sibling message arrives while the lead provider request count remains unchanged.

requirements.title: Completion and handback

reference.observation: Ordinary subagents return handbacks and completion notifications independently of team messages.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve existing child completion and retained report semantics.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: An ordinary child completes and its report arrives once after team support is enabled.

requirements.title: Shared task records

reference.observation: Task records contain identity, status, owner, dependencies, and metadata.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Maintain a shared task graph separate from membership and inboxes.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Different teammates create, read, update, and list the same task.

requirements.title: Task states and metadata

reference.observation: Tasks support pending, in-progress, completed, deletion, and metadata updates.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Implement the planned task transitions and metadata changes.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Valid state and metadata updates persist and appear in task reads.

requirements.title: Dependency-aware claims

reference.observation: Blocked tasks cannot be self-claimed until dependencies resolve.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Reject blocked self-claims and preserve explicit lead assignment as a separate rule.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A blocked self-claim fails, a lead assignment remains visible, and completion unblocks the dependent task.

requirements.title: Atomic claims

reference.observation: The plan requires a serialized read-modify-write claim transaction.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Allow one successful claimant for each available task.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Four concurrent claimants produce exactly one owner.

requirements.title: Monotonic task IDs

reference.observation: A high-water mark prevents reuse of deleted task IDs.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Persist a task ID watermark across deletion and restart.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Deleting the largest task and restarting still yields a greater new ID.

requirements.title: Task dependency validation

reference.observation: The plan requires cycle and missing-dependency validation.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Reject cycles and cross-team or missing task references without partial updates.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A cyclic or foreign dependency fails and leaves the graph unchanged.

requirements.title: Task ownership recovery

reference.observation: The plan returns unfinished owned work to pending after member termination.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Release unfinished task ownership when a teammate terminates.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: After termination, unfinished work is pending and available for a new owner.

requirements.title: Task lifecycle notices

reference.observation: Assignment and completion use distinct typed notifications.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Publish idempotent assignment and completion notices.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Replayed task notices do not repeat a transition or duplicate a visible result.

requirements.title: Task policy hook

reference.observation: The reference exposes a task-completion hook.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Run enforceable completion policy before accepting a task completion.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A rejecting completion hook leaves the task pending and returns feedback.

requirements.title: Stop background work

reference.observation: The reference stop tool can terminate a background agent or teammate by its identity.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Keep force-pause of owned work distinct from the teammate graceful shutdown handshake.

reference_relationship.reason: The reference stop tool terminates a background task or teammate. The planned Pig Litter force-pause retains resumable child state and is distinct from graceful shutdown.

requirements.acceptance_assertion: Pause retains resumable child state while approved teammate shutdown reaches its separate terminal state.

requirements.title: Task creation hook

reference.observation: The reference exposes a task-creation hook event.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Record task-creation hook support separately from task-completion policy and keep it unverified until established.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: The report shows whether task creation has an enforceable hook and cites the applicable host evidence.

requirements.title: Plan approval authority

reference.observation: Only the lead can approve a pending teammate plan and a response is correlated.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Bind plan decisions to the lead, request ID, member generation, and deadline.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Wrong-sender, stale, replayed, and self-approved responses do not authorize implementation.

requirements.title: Plan rejection and revision

reference.observation: A rejected plan carries feedback and the teammate can revise it.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Return feedback and require a new request for a revision.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A rejected plan reaches its author and the revision receives a fresh request ID.

requirements.title: Plan enforcement at tool boundary

reference.observation: The approved plan requires a side-effect veto across direct and nested tool paths.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Reject prohibited mutation before every enforceable tool call while approval is pending.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Write, shell, codemode, MCP, and delegated mutation have no side effects and report refusal.

requirements.title: Permission and sandbox separation

reference.observation: Tool permission and sandbox permission use separate request and response paths.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Bridge each permission only when a public host contract enforces it.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Permission and sandbox decisions cannot substitute for plan approval or each other.

requirements.title: Graceful shutdown

reference.observation: A teammate can approve or reject a correlated shutdown request.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Provide a shutdown handshake distinct from force pause.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Approval ends the correct member once; rejection retains it and reports a reason.

requirements.title: Request expiry and restart

reference.observation: The plan requires expiration or visible cancellation of pending decisions.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Expire or visibly cancel unanswered requests without granting approval.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Timeout and restart leave no request implicitly approved.

requirements.title: Teammate idle notices

reference.observation: Teammates report available, interrupted, or failed idle outcomes.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Emit an attributed idle result or failure once per settled turn.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Separate successful, interrupted, and failed turns produce the correct notice once.

requirements.title: Teammate idle policy hook

reference.observation: The reference exposes a teammate-idle hook.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Run enforceable idle policy without discarding pending work.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A rejecting idle hook preserves pending work and returns feedback.

requirements.title: plan_approval_request

reference.observation: The extraction identifies plan_approval_request as a mailbox frame.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the plan_approval_request behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A plan request carries the requester and a correlated request ID.

requirements.title: plan_approval_response

reference.observation: The extraction identifies plan_approval_response as a mailbox frame and structured input.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the plan_approval_response behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A lead response resolves only its matching pending plan.

requirements.title: shutdown_request

reference.observation: The extraction identifies shutdown_request as a mailbox frame and structured input.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the shutdown_request behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A shutdown request reaches the intended member with its request ID.

requirements.title: shutdown_response

reference.observation: The extraction identifies shutdown_response as a structured input and classifier form.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the shutdown_response behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A teammate response is correlated and produces an approval or rejection outcome.

requirements.title: shutdown_approved

reference.observation: The extraction identifies shutdown_approved as a mailbox frame.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the shutdown_approved behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Approval ends the matching teammate and acknowledges the request once.

requirements.title: shutdown_rejected

reference.observation: The extraction identifies shutdown_rejected as a mailbox frame.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the shutdown_rejected behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Rejection keeps the teammate addressable and returns its reason.

requirements.title: task_assignment

reference.observation: The extraction identifies task_assignment as a mailbox frame.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the task_assignment behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A task assignment identifies the task and its assigner.

requirements.title: task_completed

reference.observation: The extraction identifies task_completed as a mailbox frame.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the task_completed behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A task completion identifies the completed task and cannot be applied twice.

requirements.title: teammate_terminated

reference.observation: The extraction identifies teammate_terminated as a mailbox frame.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the teammate_terminated behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A termination notice identifies the member lifecycle outcome.

requirements.title: idle_notification

reference.observation: The extraction identifies idle_notification as a mailbox frame.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the idle_notification behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: An idle notice carries the member and its available, interrupted, or failed result.

requirements.title: permission_request

reference.observation: The extraction identifies permission_request as a out-of-band mailbox frame.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the permission_request behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A tool permission request is correlated to the originating tool call.

requirements.title: permission_response

reference.observation: The extraction identifies permission_response as a out-of-band mailbox frame.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the permission_response behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A permission response is accepted only from the authorized responder for its request.

requirements.title: sandbox_permission_request

reference.observation: The extraction identifies sandbox_permission_request as a out-of-band mailbox frame.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the sandbox_permission_request behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A sandbox request remains distinct from the tool permission request.

requirements.title: sandbox_permission_response

reference.observation: The extraction identifies sandbox_permission_response as a out-of-band mailbox frame.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the sandbox_permission_response behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A sandbox response resolves only its matching sandbox request.

requirements.title: team_permission_update

reference.observation: The extraction identifies team_permission_update as a out-of-band classifier form.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the team_permission_update behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A permission update cannot widen authority without an enforceable host contract.

requirements.title: mode_set_request

reference.observation: The extraction identifies mode_set_request as a out-of-band classifier form.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve the mode_set_request behavior where its host contract is enforceable and report any deliberate difference.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: An inbox mode-change request is rejected rather than silently granting a mode.

requirements.title: Independent session discovery

reference.observation: The reference discovers local sessions separately from teammates.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Discover opted-in independent local PiG sessions with separate identity and authority.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Two independent sessions discover each other without joining the same team.

requirements.title: Names, references, and collisions

reference.observation: Roster entries can include references and name collisions affect resolution.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Resolve names deterministically and support explicit pinned references.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A child, teammate, and independent session with the same name remain individually addressable.

requirements.title: Pinned session identity

reference.observation: The reference pins peer identity and reports restarted or contested peers.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Retain a peer identity pin and reject silent retargeting after a restart.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A stale or replaced endpoint cannot silently receive a pinned peer message.

requirements.title: Local transport outcomes

reference.observation: The local route distinguishes stale sockets, busy endpoints, pacing, size, timeout, and uncertain delivery.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Return route-specific non-success and uncertainty results.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Stale, busy, oversized, paced, and uncertain sends do not report confirmed delivery.

requirements.title: Inbound peer approval

reference.observation: Peer messages can be held for user acceptance or denial.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Require inbound acceptance or denial before enabling a peer route.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A denied inbound message never reaches the recipient model.

requirements.title: One-shot idle subscription

reference.observation: Idle subscriptions are limited to local independent sessions from the main conversation.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Support one idle or exit notice from a main conversation to an independent local session.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: The subscription fires once and teammate or subagent subscription attempts are refused.

requirements.title: Local peers have no child controls

reference.observation: The plan separates local peer references from child control authority.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Forbid child lifecycle controls on independent peers.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A local peer cannot be inspected, stopped, or resumed as a child.

requirements.title: Proprietary remote routes

reference.observation: The reference has cloud, Remote Control, and Desktop routes.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Report those proprietary routes as unsupported rather than claiming global parity.

reference_relationship.reason: The reference includes proprietary remote routes. The proposed Pig Litter scope reports those routes as unsupported.

requirements.acceptance_assertion: The report shows each unavailable proprietary route as unsupported with a reason.

requirements.title: Discovery limits

reference.observation: The reference reports list truncation and partial discovery failure.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Expose truncated and partial discovery results without treating them as a complete roster.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A discovery failure or limit is visible and does not hide already verified rows.

requirements.title: Cross-session file transfer

reference.observation: The extraction identifies separate user-file and cross-session file delivery tools.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Track file transfer separately from peer text delivery and retain an unverified status until its scope and evidence are established.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: The report identifies file-transfer evidence separately and does not infer support from peer text delivery.

requirements.title: User file delivery

reference.observation: The reference separately exposes a gated tool for delivering files to the user.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Track user-directed file delivery separately from cross-session messaging and file transfer.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: The report records the status and evidence of user-directed file delivery independently of peer text messaging.

requirements.title: Observer pairing

reference.observation: An observer report can target the observed worker or its coordinator.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Bind each observer to both an observed member and a report destination.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Reports reach the configured observed member or coordinator and no other destination.

requirements.title: Observer report tool

reference.observation: ObserverReport is a dedicated write to the paired destination.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Expose a dedicated observer report without granting ordinary mutation.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: An observer can submit its report while unrelated writes remain refused.

requirements.title: Observer tool restrictions

reference.observation: The extracted observer filter removes messaging, delegation, and selected scheduling tools, then adds the dedicated report tool.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Enforce observer restrictions at the runtime tool boundary, including the plan requirement to deny unrelated mutation.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Observer mutation, delegation, and ordinary peer sends fail while inspection remains available.

requirements.title: Bounded observer activity

reference.observation: Observers receive activity digests and can remain silent when no report is warranted.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Bound observer activity digests and permit silence.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A paired observer receives a bounded digest and can finish without sending a report.

requirements.title: Observer pairing lifecycle

reference.observation: Observer pairings track arming, stopping, and report destinations.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Retain an armed or retired pairing and reject reports from inactive pairings.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: An armed pairing delivers to its target and a retired pairing refuses later reports.

requirements.title: Observer creation trigger

reference.observation: The reference can automatically start an observer for a configured agent type.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Document whether observer creation is automatic or explicit and preserve that distinction in the parity report.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: The observed creation trigger matches the documented policy and any difference from automatic creation remains visible.

requirements.title: Teammate overview

reference.observation: The extracted team panel shows member identity, state, work, and overflow.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Show member identity, state, current work, and overflow in the terminal.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: The view distinguishes busy, idle, paused, failed, and terminated members at supported widths.

requirements.title: Member navigation and detail

reference.observation: The reference has selection, detail, foreground, stop, and back interactions.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Allow selection and passive inspection without waking a member.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Selecting a member shows its own transcript and does not trigger a provider request.

requirements.title: Task and decision controls

reference.observation: The reconstructed screens include task and approval states.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Expose tasks and correlated plan or shutdown decisions in the terminal.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A user resolves the selected request and sees the corresponding task or gate state.

requirements.title: Direct terminal messaging

reference.observation: The reference reconstructs prompt addressing for teammates.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Provide direct terminal messaging through a verified host input hook or an explicit command.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A user message reaches only the selected teammate with user attribution.

requirements.title: Accessible states and widths

reference.observation: The reference defines text labels and screen-reader paths alongside visual states.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Use text labels alongside color and keep controls usable at 80, 120, and 150 columns.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: States are understandable without color and rendered rows fit each tested width.

requirements.title: Captured background empty state

reference.observation: An empty background dialog was captured without a model turn.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve an understandable empty state in the existing terminal controls.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: An empty team or child view remains navigable and contains no phantom members.

requirements.title: Captured session listing

reference.observation: The agent view was captured with a local session list.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Distinguish independent session entries from team and child entries.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A local session list labels session identity and relationship correctly.

requirements.title: Lifecycle and delivery notices

reference.observation: Lifecycle and delivery notices were reconstructed from implementation strings.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Show member lifecycle changes and explicit message failure.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A failed send and a terminated member produce visible, distinguishable results.

requirements.title: Terminal input and recovery

reference.observation: The plan requires keyboard, resize, selection, and retained state verification.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Preserve keys, selection, and retained child controls across reload and resize.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Arrows, Enter, Escape, scrolling, resize, and reload preserve the selected identity.

requirements.title: Embedded teammate backend

reference.observation: The reference supports in-process teammates.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Run embedded teammates with the same team identity and protocol as pane members.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: An embedded teammate reaches ready state and participates in the shared team.

requirements.title: tmux backend

reference.observation: The reference launches teammates in tmux panes or sessions.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Launch selected teammates in owned tmux panes with explicit process identity.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Two tmux members use their intended directories and leave no owned panes after shutdown.

requirements.title: iTerm2 backend

reference.observation: The reference supports native iTerm2 pane teammates.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Launch and clean up iTerm2 teammates on a real supported macOS host.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: A real iTerm2 pane starts, exchanges a message, and closes under the same member identity.

requirements.title: Backend selection and fallback

reference.observation: Automatic selection chooses a backend based on terminal availability and can fall back.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Show automatic embedded fallback and reject an explicitly unavailable backend.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Unavailable auto mode falls back visibly; explicit unavailable mode fails with no orphan member.

requirements.title: Pane cleanup and ownership

reference.observation: The reference tracks pane launch and cleanup around teammate lifecycle.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Track owned process and pane identity and leave unrelated sessions untouched.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Killing or restarting a pane reports its state and cleanup affects only owned resources.

requirements.title: Independent selected extension process

reference.observation: The plan requires a real independent PiG process with explicitly selected extension tools.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Launch a separate selected PiG process using the verified host contract.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: The process identity and registered extension tools appear in retained runtime evidence.

requirements.title: Backend-specific workspaces

reference.observation: The plan requires explicit teammate directories and retained worktree ownership.

requirements.proposed_behavior: Pass the selected directory and ownership record to each backend.
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Quoted directories are preserved and separate worktrees retain uncommitted edits.
